items.title: Trip report: June 2026 ISO C++ standards meeting (Brno, Czechia)
items.content: Adopted this week in draft C++29: Complete catalog of all undefined behavior in C++. Contract pre/post support for virtual functions. Defaulting (=default) for postfix increment/decrement. Designated initializers for base classes. Python-style .lookup(key) for associative containers. And more…

items.summary: 2026年6月在捷克布尔诺召开的ISO C++标准会议通过多项草案，包括：完整列出C++中所有未定义行为、支持虚函数的契约前/后条件、默认化后置递增/递减运算符、为基类指定初始化器，以及为关联容器提供类似Python的.lookup(key)操作等。

items.summary: 2025年C++表现依旧强劲。数据显示，2022至2025年间，C++与Rust是增长最快的主流编程语言。主要原因在于：软件消耗性能的速度，始终快于硬件提升性能的速度。这一根本矛盾推动了C++的持续发展，即便面临竞争、安全性与AI等挑战。

items.title: New U.S. executive order on cybersecurity
items.content: The Biden administration just issued another executive order (EO) on hardening U.S. cybersecurity. This is all great stuff. items.creator: Herb Sutter
items.summary: 美国拜登政府发布了一项关于加强网络安全的行政命令。作者认为该命令内容积极，且其中许多措施与自己在近一年前文章中提出的建议相似，并引用了此前文章中的行动呼吁部分。

items.title: Speaking at University of Waterloo on January 15
items.content: Next week, on January 15, I’ll be speaking at the University of Waterloo, my alma mater. items.title: Trip report: November 2024 ISO C++ standards meeting (Wrocław, Poland)
items.content: On Saturday, the ISO C++ committee completed the third-last design meeting of C++26, held in Wrocław, Poland. There are just two meetings left before the C++26 feature freeze in June 2025, and C++26 is on track to be completed two more meetings after that in early 2026. Implementations are closely tracking draft C++26; GCC and … Continue reading Trip report: November 2024 ISO C++ standards meeting (Wrocław, Poland) →

items.creator: Herb Sutter
items.summary: 2024年11月，ISO C++委员会在波兰弗罗茨瓦夫召开会议，这是C++26设计阶段的倒数第三次会议。距2025年6月特性冻结仅剩两次会议，C++26预计将在2026年初完成。各编译器实现正紧密跟踪C++26草案。

items.title: A new chapter, and thoughts on a pivotal year for C++
items.content: Starting today I’m excited to be working on a new team, with my C++ standards and community roles unchanged. items.creator: Herb Sutter
items.summary: 作者宣布加入新团队，但将继续担任C++标准与社区相关职务。他认为2024年是C++发展的关键一年，因此继续投入大量时间于C++标准化与演进工作。

items.title: Podcast interview: Rust and C++
items.content: In early September I had a very enjoyable technical chat with Steve Klabnik of Rust fame and interviewer Kevin Ball of Software Engineering Daily, and the podcast is now available. Update: I asked them to please change the “Rust vs C++” title to “Rust and C++” and they kindly did so. Thanks! Here’s the info…

items.summary: 作者与Rust专家Steve Klabnik及Software Engineering Daily主持人Kevin Ball进行了一次技术播客访谈。访谈标题原为“Rust vs C++”，经作者请求后改为“Rust and C++”，强调二者并非对立关系。该播客现已上线。
